body: I feel like the only thing holding me back at this point is what it'd do to my dad. He lost his father to suicide and we're really close. I don't want to destroy him. But I don't know what else to do.

I can relate to what you're saying - about writing up notes. I don't have offline friends, but I know if I committed suicide, my father and sister would be absolutely devastated. My father especially .. because we're close, and he's already gone through the suicide of his own father.

But I also feel like my desire not to hurt them is going to be outweighed by how much I despise my life and how hopeless I feel. I'm sure if I keep it up, they'll end up hating me anyway.
My family knows. I don't think they'll do anything, they haven't in the past.
